limits.notes: No key, but a descriptive User-Agent (AppName contact@email) is mandatory. Max ~10 requests/sec per IP.

llmDocs.summary: US public-company filings, financial statements, and XBRL-tagged facts from SEC EDGAR.
llmDocs.queryGuide: CIK must be zero-padded to 10 digits. Start from /submissions/CIK{cik}.json to list filings, or pull a single metric via companyconcept (taxonomy us-gaap, tag e.g. Revenues).
gotchas: CIK must be zero-padded to 10 digits
